name: guardrails
description: 24 toggleable guards. Blocks: secrets, machine paths, hook bypass, force-push, reset --hard, open-review merges, cross-domain paths, PR-fix requests, PR body format, drive-root /tmp, MSYS_NO_PATHCONV, cd && git, foreground waits, PR polls, unsafe rm -r, expanding commit -m, off-convention titles, loopback Artifacts; opt-in, credential reads, main-checkout edits. Asks: settings writes. Warns: Workflow fan-out, bare gh pr create. Git hooks: commits, secrets, paths, CLI flags, skill and path refs.

secret_pattern_detection_enabled.title: Secret-pattern-detection guard
secret_pattern_detection_enabled.description: Blocks writes containing high-confidence secret or credential patterns. On by default.

secret_pattern_detection_allowed_roots.title: Secret-pattern-detection allowed roots
secret_pattern_detection_allowed_roots.description: Comma-separated absolute directories; a Write, Edit or NotebookEdit whose real path is strictly under one is not scanned for secrets. Empty by default. A commit is still checked only in clones where /guardrails:setup apply install-git-hooks ran. Limits: README Option details.

secret_pattern_detection_skip_gitignored.title: Secret-pattern-detection skips gitignored files
secret_pattern_detection_skip_gitignored.description: When true, a Write, Edit or NotebookEdit to a file its own repository ignores is not scanned for secrets. Off by default. A commit is still checked only in clones where /guardrails:setup apply install-git-hooks ran. Limits: README Option details.

hardcoded_path_check_enabled.title: Hardcoded-path-check guard
hardcoded_path_check_enabled.description: Blocks writes containing hardcoded machine-specific paths. On by default.

block_no_verify_enabled.title: Block-no-verify guard
block_no_verify_enabled.description: Blocks git hook-bypass attempts: --no-verify, core.hooksPath=, and hook-manager env-var disables for a configurable set (lefthook, husky, pre-commit and simple-git-hooks by default). On by default.

block_no_verify_hook_manager_prefixes.title: Block-no-verify hook-manager prefixes
block_no_verify_hook_manager_prefixes.description: Comma-separated hook-manager env-var name prefixes block-no-verify treats as a bypass when set to 0 or false (e.g. lefthook,husky). Empty, the default, uses the built-in set: lefthook, husky, pre_commit, simple_git_hooks.

block_dangerous_git_enabled.title: Block-dangerous-git guard
block_dangerous_git_enabled.description: Blocks irreversible git operations: push --force, reset --hard, clean -f, worktree-wide checkout or restore discards, and a push --force-with-lease that leases against a value git resolves at push time. On by default. The README's Option details define the lease case.

block_dangerous_git_allow.title: Block-dangerous-git allow-list
block_dangerous_git_allow.description: Comma-separated forms block-dangerous-git permits: push-force, push-lease-unsafe, reset-hard, clean-force, checkout-dot, restore-dot, checkout-force, plus the PowerShell ps-unparsable-* sink tokens the README's Option details list. Empty, the default, blocks all.

block_dangerous_git_unpinned_lease.title: Unpinned force-with-lease push
block_dangerous_git_unpinned_lease.description: allow or block. allow, the default, lets block-dangerous-git pass a lease with no full commit id: --force-with-lease plus --force-if-includes, or an empty expect. block allows only --force-with-lease=<ref>:<full-sha>. Any other value acts as allow. Team-file layer: README Option details.

block_credential_read_enabled.title: Block-credential-read guard
block_credential_read_enabled.description: Blocks a command whose output is a credential: git credential fill, gh auth token, a token-shaped variable echoed, and an interpreter (python -c, node -e) reading .env, .netrc, ~/.ssh/id_* or ~/.aws/credentials. cat is left to Read() deny rules. Off by default: precision below the bar.

block_credential_read_allow.title: Block-credential-read allow-list
block_credential_read_allow.description: Comma-separated families block-credential-read permits: credential-fill, gh-auth-token, env-echo, credential-file-read. Empty, the default, blocks all.

block_cross_domain_enabled.title: Block-cross-domain guard
block_cross_domain_enabled.description: Denies a Bash or PowerShell global git identity write (git config --global user.email and kin, a ~/.gitconfig write). In an identity domain (identity-domains.json) also denies naming another domain's path, using its marker, or gh/az without the domain's config dir. On by default.

merge_guard_enabled.title: Merge guard
merge_guard_enabled.description: Blocks a PR merge, auto-merge or merge-queue request while the PR has a hold label, an unresolved review thread, a changes-requested review, a failed check, a pending check (immediate merge only) or no pr-verify PASS where one is due. Fails open, visibly, on an unreadable PR. On by default.

merge_guard_ignored_checks.title: Merge guard ignored checks
merge_guard_ignored_checks.description: Comma-separated <app slug>:<check name> pairs the merge guard never judges as pending or failing, the only way a failed check is cleared. The default names the pr-merge lane's merge job, which runs as the merger, not a gate, by display name and by job id. Empty judges every check.

block_lane_pr_disable_auto_enabled.title: Block-lane-PR-disable-auto guard
block_lane_pr_disable_auto_enabled.description: Blocks gh pr merge --disable-auto, or the disablePullRequestAutoMerge mutation through gh api graphql, on a pull request the lanes App opened, and says to hold it with the do-not-merge label instead. A target it cannot read is blocked. On by default.

block_lane_pr_disable_auto_app.title: Lanes app login
block_lane_pr_disable_auto_app.description: The GitHub App login (slug, app/<slug> or <slug>[bot]) whose pull requests block-lane-pr-disable-auto protects. Empty, the default, blocks a disable on any pull request a GitHub App opened, since the guard cannot tell which App is the lanes App; a pull request a person opened passes.

block_fix_request_post_enabled.title: Block-fix-request-post guard
block_fix_request_post_enabled.description: Blocks an agent from posting the PR-fix lane fix request (a line starting "PR-fix lane: please fix this finding") to GitHub through gh, curl or a GitHub MCP write tool. Only the owner posts it, in the GitHub UI. On by default.

block_github_post_content_enabled.title: Block-github-post-content guard
block_github_post_content_enabled.description: Blocks a Bash or PowerShell gh or curl command whose GitHub post body holds a secret or a hardcoded machine path, using the secret-pattern-detection and hardcoded-path-check patterns; their options also turn off their half here. On by default.

block_body_format_violation_enabled.title: Block-body-format-violation guard
block_body_format_violation_enabled.description: Blocks gh pr create, gh pr edit with a body, gh issue create, or a GitHub MCP pull request write or issue create whose body breaks the format the target repository declares in docs/conventions/source-control.yaml; a repository that declares none is not judged. On by default.

block_windows_drive_tmp_enabled.title: Block-Windows-drive-tmp guard
block_windows_drive_tmp_enabled.description: Blocks writes to a Windows drive-root temp path (/tmp, C:\tmp, \tmp, /c/tmp) that resolves to <drive>:\tmp instead of %TEMP%, in shell commands and Write/Edit file paths alike. On by default. The Git for Windows exception is in the README's Option details.

block_exported_msys_pathconv_enabled.title: Block-exported-MSYS-pathconv guard
block_exported_msys_pathconv_enabled.description: Blocks a leaking MSYS path-conversion suppressor on Windows: an exported MSYS_NO_PATHCONV or MSYS2_ARG_CONV_EXCL, or one prefixed on a child shell (MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1 bash -c ...). On by default. What it does not match is in the README's Option details.

block_cd_prefix_enabled.title: Block-cd-prefix guard
block_cd_prefix_enabled.description: Denies a Bash command that opens with cd <path> followed by &&, ; or a newline and then runs git or writes to a relative path, with the reason to use git -C <abs path>. cd . and a cd to the current directory pass. On by default.

block_main_checkout_edit_enabled.title: Block-main-checkout-edit guard
block_main_checkout_edit_enabled.description: Denies a Write, Edit or NotebookEdit to a file that is not git-ignored in a repository's main checkout while it is on the remote default branch (origin/HEAD), with the steps to make the edit in a worktree. Linked worktrees, other branches and a detached HEAD pass. Off by default; true turns it on.

block_foreground_wait_enabled.title: Block-foreground-wait guard
block_foreground_wait_enabled.description: Denies a foreground Bash command that waits with an until loop or a --watch flag, with the reason to set run_in_background or use the Monitor tool. A call with run_in_background set to true passes. On by default.

block_foreground_wait_script_runners.title: Block-foreground-wait script runners
block_foreground_wait_script_runners.description: Comma-separated command words that pass the arguments after -- to the script they run, so block-foreground-wait still finds a --watch there (npm test -- --watch). Any other command stops the scan at --. Empty stops every scan at --.

block_pr_poller_enabled.title: Block-pr-poller guard
block_pr_poller_enabled.description: Denies a Monitor or background Bash command that loops, sleeps and polls a pull request with gh pr view, checks or status, or gh api, with the reason to use /source-control:pull-request monitor or gh event listen. The monitor skill's monitor-poll.sh passes. On by default.

block_root_delete_target_enabled.title: Block-root-delete-target guard
block_root_delete_target_enabled.description: Blocks a recursive delete (rm, Remove-Item, rd /s) of a filesystem, home, drive or UNC root, an empty or bare-variable operand, a protected tree (.git, repo or worktree root, ~/.claude, other sessions' scratchpads), or a path outside the repo, temp, the scratchpad and allowed roots. On by default.

block_root_delete_target_allowed_roots.title: Block-root-delete-target allowed roots
block_root_delete_target_allowed_roots.description: Comma-separated absolute directories; a recursive delete passes when its real path is strictly under one. An entry like D:/worktrees/.tmp-* allows only direct children whose name extends that prefix. Empty by default; adds to the temp roots and scratchpad. Limits: README Option details.

block_root_delete_target_protected_trees.title: Block-root-delete-target protected trees
block_root_delete_target_protected_trees.description: Comma-separated absolute directories a recursive delete never removes, even under the repo or an allowed root: the directory, anything under it, and a directory holding it are refused. Empty by default; adds to the built-in protected trees. Limits: README Option details.

block_noncanonical_commit_enabled.title: Block-noncanonical-commit guard
block_noncanonical_commit_enabled.description: Blocks git commit -m when the message holds a $ or a backtick the shell would expand (single-quote it, or pipe it via -F -); a plain message passes, multi-line included. On by default. Exempt: --amend, -C/-c, --fixup/--squash, -F <path>, and an in-progress merge or rebase.

block_noncanonical_commit_allow.title: Block-noncanonical-commit allow-list
block_noncanonical_commit_allow.description: Comma-separated form tokens block-noncanonical-commit permits. The only token today is message-flag, which permits a -m message the shell would expand. Empty, the default, permits none.

block_convention_gate_enabled.title: Block-convention-violation guard
block_convention_gate_enabled.description: Blocks a commit subject or gh pr create --title off the team-tracked pattern in docs/conventions/source-control.yaml, else docs/conventions/source-control/commit-convention.yml. On by default; with no tracked or personal pattern nothing is enforced. Same exemptions as block-noncanonical-commit.

git_hooks_notice_enabled.title: Git-hooks notice
git_hooks_notice_enabled.description: At session start, names /guardrails:setup apply install-git-hooks once when this clone lacks a guardrails git-hook entry or holds a drifted one; a declined entry stays quiet. Turning it off also silences the session-start notice that jq is missing. On by default.

workflow_resilience_check_enabled.title: Workflow-resilience-check guard
workflow_resilience_check_enabled.description: Advises on Workflow fan-out with no wave cap of its own; never blocks. Off by default: a behavioral-class prose injector, held off by the instruction-economy evidence gate. Set true to turn it on.

flag_commit_pr_skill_bypass_enabled.title: Flag-commit-PR-skill-bypass guard
flag_commit_pr_skill_bypass_enabled.description: Advises when a direct gh pr create bypasses the source-control pull-request skill; never blocks. Off by default: a behavioral-class prose injector, held off by the instruction-economy evidence gate. Set true to turn it on.

settings_write_ask_enabled.title: Settings-write-ask hook
settings_write_ask_enabled.description: Runs the PreToolUse hook that asks before Write, Edit, and NotebookEdit calls aimed at a Claude Code settings file. On by default. Shell writes and files rendered into place are outside its matcher.

connected_page_guard_enabled.title: Connected-page guard
connected_page_guard_enabled.description: Runs the PreToolUse hook that denies an Artifact publish of an HTML page whose content security policy names a loopback connect-src. On by default. Turn off to allow publishing such a page.

stdin_read_timeout.title: Hook stdin read timeout (seconds)
stdin_read_timeout.description: Idle bound on reading the hook payload from stdin: how long a silent pipe is tolerated before a blocking guard fails closed. Default 2. Only a JSON payload the pipe closed on mid-document is allowed with a notice; a stalled pipe stays a block.

deny_on_crash.title: Guards that deny the call when they crash
deny_on_crash.description: Comma-separated guard names (e.g. block-dangerous-git) whose crash denies the tool call instead of allowing it with the guard-did-not-run notice. Empty, the default, lets every crashed guard allow with the notice. An unknown name is reported and ignored. Team-file layer: README Option details.
